basic_info.description: Located in the heart of Noe Valley this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom Edwardian Condo offers a perfect blend of charm, space, and period details. With a house-like feel, the upper level welcomes you with an inviting entry foyer that leads to a double parlor with classic pocket doors and adjacent home office. The formal dining room exudes character with its classic built-in cabinetry and picturesque windows overlooking the backyard. The French country kitchen is well-appointed with ample storage, modern appliances and a full size wine fridge. It also includes a charming dining nook and a door to the staircase leading to the private cozy backyard. For added convenience, a full bathroom & powder room are located off the hallway.  The lower level features a spacious two-room primary suite with a large built-in closet, washer/dryer and access to the exclusive-use backyard. A comfortable media room connects to two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom. A 2-car detached garage is located behind the building. Situated just steps from the vibrant shops and restaurants along 24th Street and a short stroll to Dolores Park, public transportation, & tech buses, this condo offers the best of Noe Valley living with a walk score of 99.
